kjv: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? (KJV 58:1)
mine: Do you indeed decree what is right, you gods?
note: MT 'elem "silence" makes little sense; most read 'elim "gods" (the divine rulers condemned as in Ps 82), while the KJV takes it as "congregation" (perhaps from 'alam "bind together"); the psalm then rebukes heavenly, not human, judges. Context: you gods ('elim: rulers or divine beings) (medium confidence). MT 'elem 'silence' scarcely works as an address; nearly all modern versions read the same consonants as 'elim 'gods, mighty ones'. 'Your hands deal out violence on earth' (v. 3) and Ps 82 point to powers who judge; whether they are human rulers or heavenly beings is left open by 'you gods'. Other possible meanings: (1) 'O congregation' — KJV, taking 'elem as 'band, assembly'; (2) 'you silent ones' / 'in silence' — MT vowels, Rashi, NKJV; (3) 'you rulers / mighty ones' (human leaders) — NIV, NET, CSB, NJPS; (4) heavenly beings judged as in Ps 82:1, 6 — some commentators.
